stories.headline: Parents sue OpenAI, alleging GPT-4o coached their daughter off seizure medication

stories.headline: Meta quietly launched an ‘AI pet journal’ app
stories.dek:
Meta has launched a "tamagotchi-style" pet game called Waddle World, with virtual creatures that chat with users and create doodles to illustrate conversations.
According to its Apple and Play Store listings, the "16-bit pet care game" is not really a game, but "a daily journal disguised as a pet."
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Julio Lopez on Unsplash
